title: Even More Totems
description: Totem Plus adds 16 special Totems and one Creative-only infinite Totem to Minecraft. Each Totem has its own unique survival effect.
body:
Even More Totems adds 16 new special Totems and one Creative-only infinite Totem to Minecraft.

Each Totem has its own unique survival effect. You can summon wolves, create a stone shelter, slow time, heal yourself, strike enemies with lightning, summon spiders, call a shadow fighter, and more.

The mod also includes custom Totem textures, crafting recipes, advancements, custom pop animations, a Totem Guide, gamerules, and English/German language support.
